ledger.zero_recovery: Stress case only, NOT known historical economic total loss
ledger.full_recovery: Optimistic case only, NOT proof historical execution
ledger.interim_open_position_nav: Book at original entry cost, not true historical mark-to-market
ledger.same_shard_origin: same original frozen Stage26 WATCH events, no new model parameters
